    1v1 Backpedal Attack

    Finishing, Ball Handling, Individual Offense, Individual Defense, Warm-Up

    Retreat to the free-throw line, then change direction and attack.

    Main Goal

    Help ball handlers maintain control while dribbling backward, then read the defender and create an advantage when changing direction toward the basket.

    Setup

    1. One offensive player (O1) starts with the ball inside the paint, facing the basket.

    2. One defender (X1) stands in front of O1, facing the ball handler.

    Finishing
    Ball Handling
    Individual Offense
    Individual Defense

    1v1 Bump Finish

    Ball Handling, Conditioning, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Finishing, Warm-Up

    Absorb shoulder contact, stay balanced, and finish under pressure.

    Main Goal
    Help ball handlers maintain balance and ball control through contact, then finish against a defender alongside them.

    Setup

    1. One ball handler (O1) starts at a chosen position with a ball.

    2. One defender (X1) stands shoulder to shoulder beside O1. Both players face the basket.

    Ball Handling
    Conditioning
    Individual Offense

    1v1 Cone Chase Shooting

    Shooting, Individual Offense, Decision Making

    Sprint into your shot and beat the defender’s contest.

    Main Goal

    Help shooters get their feet ready, receive the pass, and release a balanced shot under pressure while training defenders to recover quickly and contest.

    Setup

    1. One offensive player (O1) starts with the ball at the top, facing a defender (X1).

    2. Place one cone to the left and one to the right of the pair.

    3. A passer (O2) stands at the free-throw line.

    Shooting

    1v1 Cone Escape Shooting

    Small-Sided Games, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Finishing, Passing

    Create separation without the ball and turn the catch into a scoring opportunity.

    Main Goal

    Help offensive players use changes of pace and direction to get open, time their cuts with the passer, and recognize whether to finish or pass back and relocate.

    Setup

    1. One offensive player (O1) starts without the ball at the free-throw line, facing a defender (X1).

    2. Place one cone at each elbow.

    3. A passer starts with the ball outside the three-point line.

    Small-Sided Games
    Individual Offense
    Decision Making
    Finishing

    1v1 Corner Skip Closeout

    Individual Defense, Shooting, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Passing

    Sprint recovery, closeout technique, and immediate decision-making.

    Main Goal

    Train defenders to sprint into controlled closeouts after ball movement, while offensive players learn to attack or shoot decisively under pressure.

    Setup

    A defender starts with the ball in one corner and passes it to a passer/coach at the free-throw line.

    Individual Defense

    1v1 High-Five Scramble

    Small-Sided Games, Conditioning

    Win the ball, get to your feet, and finish against a chasing defender.

    Main Goal

    Develop quick reactions and body control while training players to turn a loose-ball win into an immediate attack and finish under pressure.

    Setup

    1. Two players face each other at half court in a push-up position.

    2. Place one ball between them on the half-court line, within reach of both players.

    3. Designate the basket they will attack.

    Small-Sided Games

    1v1 Kick-Out Shooting

    Shooting, Decision Making, Passing

    Competitive shooting under pressure.

    Main Goal

    Develop shooting consistency under pressure and decision making.

    Setup

    Start with a 1-on-1 situation and one additional shooter positioned anywhere around the arc.

    1v1 Lead Pass Chase

    Small-Sided Games, Individual Offense, Finishing, Passing

    Create separation, receive the pass in stride, and finish before the defender recovers.

    Main Goal
    Train receivers to create an advantage with an explosive cut, while helping passers time and place a lead pass for a finish under pressure.

    Setup

    1. O1 starts with the ball near one sideline at half court.

    2. O2 starts near the opposite sideline at half court, guarded by X2.

    3. Both baskets are available, depending on O2’s chosen direction.

    Small-Sided Games

    1v1 Midline Gate Decision

    Small-Sided Games, Ball Handling, Conditioning, Individual Defense, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Finishing, Warm-Up

    Full-court 1v1 with change-of-direction read after midline touch.

    Main Goal

    Train change-of-pace and change-of-direction decisions for the ball-handler while developing defensive reaction speed, recovery angles, and containment in open space.

    Setup

    1. One ball-handler (O1) and one defender (X1) start next to each other behind the baseline. O1 has the ball.

    2. At the opposite half (midcourt), two cones form a small gate on the midline. Both players must run forward and touch the midline (at least one foot on or beyond it).

    Small-Sided Games

    1v1 Rock, Paper, Scissors

    Finishing, Decision Making, Small-Sided Games, Individual Offense, Individual Defense, Conditioning

    Win the ball, react quickly, and turn the result into a live 1v1.

    Main Goal
    Develop quick reactions and immediate transitions into offense or defense, with an emphasis on attacking before the defender gets set.

    Setup

    1. Two players stand side by side at half court, with one ball on the floor between them.

    2. Designate the basket they will attack.

    Finishing

    1v1 Shoulder Pressure

    Finishing, Ball Handling, Individual Offense, Individual Defense

    Absorb contact, change direction, and attack against a recovering defender.

    Main Goal

    Help ball handlers maintain balance under contact and create an advantage with a sudden change of direction, while training defenders to react, recover, and contest the finish.

    Setup

    1. One ball handler (O1) and one defender (X1) start shoulder to shoulder at the free-throw line.

    2. O1 and X1 both face the basket. O1 starts with the ball.

    2v1 + 1 Full Court

    Small-Sided Games, Conditioning, Transition Offense, Decision Making, Finishing, Passing, Transition Defense

    Attack the early advantage, read the recovering defense, and transition immediately.

    Main Goal

    Help players exploit a temporary numbers advantage before help arrives, then react quickly to changing roles in continuous full-court play.

    Setup

    1. Two attackers (O1 and O2) start with one ball against one defender (X1) in the backcourt.

    2. A second defender (X2) waits at the half-court line.

    3. Use the full court, with the center circle as X2’s recovery checkpoint.

    Small-Sided Games
    Conditioning
    Transition Offense
    Decision Making

    2v1 Big Block Reaction

    Finishing, Individual Offense, Individual Defense

    React to the pass and finish before the defender can contest.

    Main Goal
    Help attackers finish quickly under pressure while training the defender to locate the ball, react, and contest an unexpected close-range shot.

    Setup

    1. O1 and O2 start at the low blocks, one on each side of the paint.

    2. A coach stands at the free-throw line with a ball.

    3. X1 starts between the attackers with their back to the coach.

    4. Additional attackers wait off the court, ready to enter in pairs.

    Finishing
    Individual Offense

    2v1 Bullet Pass

    Small-Sided Games, Individual Defense, Decision Making, Passing

    Fast 2v1 that forces instant spacing + a quick, accurate pass under pressure.

    Main Goal

    Train quick spacing and a high-quality 'bullet pass' to beat a recovering defender, while teaching the defender to read and choose between stopping the pass or protecting the rim.

    Setup

    1. Three players line up in a straight line at the three-point line (same lane), one behind another.

    2. Back player = ball-handler (O1). In front of him stands an off-ball attacker (O2). In front of O2 stands the defender (X1) facing the basket.

    Small-Sided Games
    Individual Defense
    Decision Making
    Passing

    2v1 Elbow Attack

    Individual Defense, Shooting, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Finishing, Passing

    Attack from the elbows and create a finish with no more than one pass.

    Main Goal
    Help attackers read a single defender and decide whether to finish or use one pass to create a better scoring opportunity.

    Setup

    1. O1 and O2 start at the elbows, one on each side.

    2. A coach stands at the top with a ball.

    3. X1 starts between the attackers, facing the coach.

    4. Additional attackers wait off the court, ready to enter in pairs.

    Individual Defense

    2v1 Two-Pass Shooting

    Shooting, Individual Offense, Decision Making, Finishing

    Read the closeout, find the open shooter, and finish within two passes.

    Main Goal
    Help shooters recognize when to shoot or move the ball against a recovering defender, while developing quick decisions and readiness on the catch.

    Setup

    1. Two shooters (O1 and O2) start at designated shooting spots.

    2. One defender (X1) starts inside the court, ready to close out to either shooter.

    3. A passer or coach stands in the paint with a ball.

    2v2 Around the Arc

    Finishing, Decision Making, Small-Sided Games, Pick and Roll

    Connect through a handoff and turn the exchange into an advantage.

    Main Goal
    Help players coordinate the timing and spacing of a dribble handoff, read the defense, and create a scoring opportunity in live 2v2.

    Setup

    1. Two offensive players start in opposite corners. O1 has the ball.

    2. X1 guards O1, and X2 guards O2.

    2v2 Baseline Reload

    Small-Sided Games, Conditioning, Transition Offense, Decision Making, Transition Defense

    Continuous 2-on-2 Baseline Transition Drill.

    Main Goal

    Develop fast transition reactions, continuous play, and defensive communication under pressure.

    Setup

    1. Start with two offensive players and two defenders playing live 2-on-2.

    2. Two additional offensive players wait behind the baseline on each side of the floor.

    2v2 Chair Chase

    Small-Sided Games, Ball Handling, Decision Making, Finishing, Passing

    A competitive 2v2 drill that creates an immediate advantage and forces all four players to make quick decisions.

    Main Goal

    Help players recognize and use an early advantage in a live 2v2 situation while improving spacing, communication, and decision-making on both sides of the ball.

    Setup

    1. One offensive player starts with the ball below the first defender, while a second offensive player is positioned at the top.

    2. Place one chair or cone between O1 and X1.

    3. A second defender starts underneath the basket.

    Small-Sided Games
    Ball Handling
    Decision Making
    Finishing

    2v2 Corner Drive

    Team Offense, Small-Sided Games, Shooting, Team Defense, Decision Making, Passing

    Competitive shooting under pressure.

    Main Goal

    Force a paint touch and create a high-quality finish or kick-out against help defense.

    Setup

    1. The ball handler and primary defender start in the corner, both outside the 3-point line.

    2. A second defender waits under the basket, ready to help as the attacker enters the lane.

    3. A second attacker stands in the opposite corner, positioned for a kick-out pass.
